parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Source from molecule_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123860' and compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
